name: Scite
tagline: Search scientific papers and see how they cite each other
description: Scite is an AI-powered platform that helps researchers discover and evaluate scientific literature, using Smart Citations to show whether studies support or contradict a claim.
features: Assistant and search across scientific literature
Smart Citations showing whether studies support or contradict a claim
Paper collections (up to 1,000 on Basic, 10,000 on Pro)
API access and MCP credits on paid plans
useCases: Checking how a paper has been cited
Finding supporting or contradicting evidence for a claim
strengths: Citation context rather than just citation counts
A 7-day free trial on Basic and Pro
limitations: No free plan was stated on the pricing page
Prices are shown billed yearly; the monthly-billing price is not stated

pricing.trial: Basic and Pro list a 7-day free trial that lets you explore all premium features without commitment.

plans.name: Basic
plans.billing: $12 per month, billed yearly (the page shows a $96 saving)

plans.name: Pro
plans.billing: $40 per month, billed yearly (the page shows a $120 saving)
highlights: API access, including a $60 API credit shown as limited time

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Custom pricing based on users and usage; collections up to 50,000 papers and unlimited users with pooled usage

pricing.regional: Prices were shown with a '$' sign. Tax and regional pricing: not stated.
